sloka: जनस्थान वधम् चैव वधम् चैव जटायुषः ।हरणम् चैव वैदेह्या वालिनः च वधम् तथा ।राम कोपम् च वदताम् हरीणाम् भयम् आगतः ॥४-५५-२२॥
transliteration: janasthāna vadham caiva vadham caiva jaṭāyuṣaḥ ।haraṇam caiva vaidehyā vālinaḥ ca vadham tathā ।rāma kopam ca vadatām harīṇām bhayam āgataḥ ॥4-55-22॥

translations.english: Overtaken by the fear of death, the monkeys kept talking about Rama's exile into the forest, Dasaratha's death, destruction of demons in Janasthana, the death of Jatayu, abduction of Sita, Vali's death and Rama's anger.
